name: Fleet Broadband
summary: Perth wholesale Internet infrastructure provider; acquired Paradox Digital c.2001 and XiS's WA ADSL customer base 2002; Eftel (Datafast) was a major investor; became DFT Wholesale (Fleet Broadband Holdings Pty Ltd, ACN 096 576 377).

events.details: Perth wholesale provider; existed by 2001 when it acquired Paradox Digital (Gemini ABN date of 2004 contradicted its 2002 Datafast deal).
Acquired XiS's Western Australian ADSL customer base (confirmed by Fleet National Sales Manager John Lane, 1 Aug 2002); a full takeover of XiS was considered but did not proceed.
